title: Salt Lake City, UT — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Salt Lake City, UT: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Salt Lake City is a city in UT with a population of 199,723. Mormon capital with world-class skiing, low unemployment, and stunning mountain scenery. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.0.
